scope: Secondary descriptive analyses attached to RQ1. They do not create a new RQ and do not replace primary RQ1 precision/recall/F1 or traceability metrics.

population.rule: Only policy-eligible RQ1 reference routes enter the primary observability/taxonomy population. POLICY_BLOCKED routes remain separate transparency diagnostics.

observability_budget.role: Secondary descriptive characterization of how much functional structure is observable and safely actionable from the UI under the frozen acquisition policy.

eligible_route_detection_coverage.numerator: Count of policy-eligible RQ1 reference routes represented as detected functional screens in the immutable FORMAL003 M1 output.

visual_identity_evidence_coverage.numerator: Count of policy-eligible RQ1 routes whose detected screen has a non-empty observed in_screen_title.

visual_identity_conditional_coverage.numerator: Detected functional screens with non-empty observed in_screen_title.
visual_identity_conditional_coverage.denominator: Detected functional screens among the 57 policy-eligible RQ1 routes.

canonical_control_classification_rate.denominator: All canonical controls in immutable FORMAL003 M1 canonical output.

unknown_autoexploration_rate.numerator: Unknown event candidates present in selected_for_exploration.
unknown_autoexploration_rate.denominator: All event candidates classified as unknown in the FORMAL003 event-policy audit.
unknown_autoexploration_rate.safety_interpretation: Unknown is review/deny under the frozen policy. A non-zero numerator is a policy-deviation flag and must be reported; it does not silently alter RQ1 denominators.

ui_interaction_failure_rate.numerator: Attempted UI-event result rows with interaction_failed, execution_error, restore_failed, or non-empty error.
ui_interaction_failure_rate.denominator: All attempted UI-event result rows in immutable FORMAL003 M1 review artifacts.
ui_interaction_failure_rate.report: count/count and proportion with failure category/route breakdown

unavailable_route_share.numerator: Routes recorded unavailable by the FORMAL003 acquisition.
unavailable_route_share.denominator: All visited/discovered routes in the FORMAL003 acquisition.
unavailable_route_share.report: count/count and proportion; engineering/observability diagnostic, not primary RQ1 F1

observability_budget.inference: Descriptive only. No new significance test is introduced.

mutually_exclusive_categories.rule: Reference route is policy-eligible but no functional detected screen exists for the normalized route.
Reference name and observed in_screen_title are both non-empty and equal after normalize_text.
Reference name is non-empty but observed in_screen_title is empty.
Reference name and observed in_screen_title are both non-empty but differ after normalize_text.
Reference name is empty and observed in_screen_title is non-empty.
Reference name and observed in_screen_title are both empty.

identity_discrepancy_taxonomy.assignment: Deterministic from frozen RQ1 reference + immutable FORMAL003 screen_index. No post-hoc human category creation.
identity_discrepancy_taxonomy.report: Counts and percentages for all categories; mismatches may be illustrated qualitatively without changing categories.

carried_forward_without_change.rq3_inter_rater: Cohen's kappa for expected_behavior_correct + raw agreement on frozen shared subset; safety agreement reported separately.
carried_forward_without_change.development_model_selection_benchmarks: Reportable in Methods/artifact characterization; explicitly not formal RQ evidence.
